top_signals.title: AI shopping agents are having a moment, but Amazon and a growing number of sites threaten to stunt their growth
top_signals.summary: AI shopping agents from OpenAI, Meta, Google and Instinct promise to help users shop, but they're hitting roadblocks at Amazon and other retailers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Trump demands probe into 'record setting error' after third-quarter GDP data gets massive revision higher
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump on Thursday deemed the latest gross domestic product revision a mistake, claiming that it should be "immediately investigated."
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
